description: Pakistan Reinsurance Company Limited (PRCL) is the country's national reinsurer and the only reinsurance company operating in Pakistan. It was established in 1952 as the Pakistan Insurance Corporation under the Pakistan Insurance Corporation Act 1952, to support the local insurance industry, and is a public-sector company under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce. It provides treaty and facultative reinsurance to local insurers and manages insurance schemes assigned to it by the federal government, writing aviation, marine cargo, marine hull, engineering, fire and accident business. Its head office is in Karachi and it has a zonal office in Lahore; seven of its directors are nominated by the federal government and the rest are elected by shareholders.
